open_points.subject: advance_run readiness
open_points.text: A node is ready when every input port holds its value: flow inputs delivered along every edge from them — a flow input or flow output endpoint is the node whose node_id is the empty string (A05 rule 2), never the flow_id —, constants to their port — a FlowConstant's value is the value_id of the StoredValue composition wrote, delivered as a StoredValuesRef naming it, published again by nothing —, and outputs of a concluded succeeded node along every edge whose guard is absent or whose guard port value equals the guard value as canonical JSON text.
open_points.other_text: a node none of whose elements without a concluded record can execute is not ready
open_points.question: Must readiness require only that every input port holds its value, or must it additionally require at least one unconcluded, non-waiting element that can execute?
